integrity: Infinite order is proved by exact good reductions at two degree-one primes; the Eisenstein-module conclusion uses standard finite-kernel facts for elliptic-curve endomorphisms. No finite computation is extrapolated to an infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the subgroup generated by the three critical values, not the full Mordell--Weil group over the relevant number fields and not the saturation index of that subgroup.
title: The Cartwright--Steger critical values form a non-torsion Eisenstein orbit
